thread:
carmen: Postmortem follow-up for the recurring 02:00 pager waves. We saw three patterns: flapping upstream, noisy synthetic checks, and broad rule selectors. Need owners, small experiments, and a fast canary plan.
hiro: I'll own grouping + dedupe. Idea: group by (service, request_id_prefix) and 30s sliding dedupe to avoid duplicates from retries. ETA: 6 business days.
leah: I'll take threshold tuning. Running p95/p99 per-check and want to bump noisy checks to p99 with a 2m for window. ETA: 4 days.
notify-bot: Incident 2025-07-02: nightly-pager-wave  214 pages between 02:00-03:30. Runbook: https://redwood.incidents/2025-07-02-nightwave (auto-attached).
carmen: For paging policy, propose soft-page to #alerts for synthetic / non-customer-impact checks, hard-page for SLA breaches. Need a canary: pick 3 low-traffic services for 48h. Who drafts the rollout?
raj: I can draft the rollout & canary runbook. Will include success criteria (<=10% delta in total pages, no missed SLA pages). ETA: 5 days.
hiro: local dedupe test snippet I'm trying:
```yaml
alert: retry-loop-detect
expr: sum by(service, request_prefix) (rate(retries_total[2m]))
for: 3m
group_by: [service, request_prefix]
dedupe_window: 30s
```
leah: Query I'm running to classify noisy checks:
```
SELECT check_name, count(*) as fires, percentile_disc(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (value) as p99
FROM synthetic_alerts
WHERE ts > now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY check_name
HAVING count(*) > 10
ORDER BY fires DESC;
```
carmen: Add all PRs and docs to the tracker: https://docs.redwood/pmt/alert-patterns. We'll convert these into JIRA: owners, ETAs, risk, rollback plan.
raj: I'll include an explicit rollback: revert grouping/dedupe changes and re-enable previous rules. Also mention who can trigger immediate rollback (SRE lead).
hiro: I'll push a staging PR with test vectors tomorrow morning and tag @leah and @carmen.
leah: I'll attach baseline graphs to the tracker after my job runs tonight.
notify-bot: Reminder: weekly oncall sync 2025-07-05 09:00 PST. Agenda added: alert-pattern followup.
carmen: Great  we'll use this thread for status. If anyone sees unexpected customer impact during canary, post here and we'll rollback. :thumbsup:
raj: ack, creating the canary doc now.
hiro: ack, will ping when PR is ready.
leah: ack.
